contexts.text: To slay his son () = until whatever was from the merely human was dead.
Slaying slay, and make ready () = by the goods of the exterior Natural; for to slay involves that which was slain.
To slay (the passover) = preparation for the enjoyment. AC 7917.
And shall slay it () = shall extinguish it. AC 9156:end.
To slay, when predicated of the animals which were offered, = preparation for the things represented by the sacrifices. Enumerated. AC 10045. Compare AC 10678.
To slay, or sacrifice, an ox () = to worship God in externals...
To slay the children () = to extinguish truths.
Slain from the foundation of the world () = the Divine in His Human not acknowledged from the foundation of this Church.
